name: instrumentTestTime
description: Time of last equipment test. Set to 0 if not recorded.

name: sensorSensitivity
description: Sensor sensitivity. Divide by this number to achieve a physical unit (byte 31 of THEB1)

name: serialNumber
description: Serial number of sensor for this receiver. Left-justified

name: headerBlockType
description: Must be 42 (hex) or 65 (decimal) for sensor info header.
